description: Directed, sparse suggestions after causal framing. All initial cells are unvalidated hypotheses. Missing cells are unknown. Identical parameter pairs require separation, not a matrix lookup.

cells.mechanism: Precompute or determinize stable work and reserve independent checks for relevant failure modes.
cells.conditions: The stable subtask and acceptance criteria are specified; verification overhead is measured.

cells.mechanism: Replace repeated ineffective work with a discriminating test or a source correction while preserving all acceptance criteria.
cells.conditions: The repeat is not justified waiting and the proposed change preserves required deliverables.

cells.mechanism: Use an existing deterministic check and a compact evidence-preserving context instead of repeatedly interpreting the whole history.
cells.conditions: The compact context retains necessary constraints and sources; removed detail is recoverable.

cells.mechanism: Route routine work to a measured sufficient mechanism and escalate only when its acceptance boundary is unmet.
cells.conditions: Equivalent task results are evaluated and all routing, fallback and verification costs are counted.

cells.mechanism: Reuse previously obtained evidence only while its inputs and source version remain valid, and refresh when the state changes.
cells.conditions: Freshness is observable and missed changes can be measured; v0.1 has no automatic validator for this protected parameter.

cells.mechanism: Move a recurring correctness invariant into its existing owning tool or check instead of adding repeated general reasoning.
cells.conditions: The invariant is causal and stable, and its implementation and maintenance cost is included.

cells.mechanism: Keep authorized reversible work autonomous, verify its result, and intervene on meaningful constraint deviations.
cells.conditions: The mandate is explicit and the relevant effects are reversible or otherwise bounded; required approvals remain required.

cells.mechanism: Separate task execution from existing stop and rollback controls, so autonomy does not require ignoring supervision.
cells.conditions: Controls operate on the actual task process and their effect is verified, not merely acknowledged.

cells.mechanism: Retain the full source archive while retrieving only scoped findings and their evidence for the present task.
cells.conditions: Applicability metadata is available, negative evidence is retained and omitted source detail remains retrievable.

cells.mechanism: Reuse existing archives and test runners; retire ineffective rules instead of creating another permanent service for each learning.
cells.conditions: The required functions fit existing components and removal preserves provenance and accepted behavior.

cells.mechanism: Capture acceptance evidence as work occurs and reuse task-specific checks rather than reconstructing proof at the end.
cells.conditions: Evidence capture is low overhead and the acceptance checks cover the material claim.

cells.mechanism: Separate experimental changes from the active validated configuration and advance only scoped measured interventions.
cells.conditions: Configurations are versioned, comparisons are meaningful and a previous working version can be restored.

cells.mechanism: Classify observed failure conditions and select a bounded retry or alternative using relevant evidence.
cells.conditions: An alternative exists, duplicate side effects are controlled and transient versus persistent failures can be distinguished adequately.

cells.mechanism: Remove duplicated ownership and place the invariant in one canonical implementation with a relevant regression check.
cells.conditions: The invariant is genuinely shared and the refactor preserves observable contracts.

cells.mechanism: Retrieve source-backed evidence by the current decision and scope, then load further detail only if it changes the decision.
cells.conditions: Retrieval misses are measured and summaries preserve important exceptions and constraints.

cells.mechanism: Batch independent existing work and index only required views before introducing additional coordination components.
cells.conditions: The measured bottleneck is compatible with batching or indexing and task isolation is preserved.

cells.mechanism: Detect a specific unmet deliverable or unproductive approach and direct remaining work at its acceptance condition.
cells.conditions: Completion criteria are stable, interruption does not discard useful running work, and supervisory overhead is bounded.
